run_multinode_wrapper: run a SLURM multinode wrapper script to launch distributed training across multiple nodes
run_distributed_training: run distributed training by passing a python script and config file as arguments to the wrapper
run_nccl_backend: run a distributed training job using the NCCL backend with automatic rank and world size from SLURM
review_multinode_wrapper: review the SLURM multinode wrapper script that constructs and executes distributed training commands
summarize_multinode_wrapper: summarize the multinode wrapper script that reads SLURM env vars and launches distributed python processes
